admission.justification: Invariant publication and display by builds that serve the KNO-R04 title contract. The cited tests exercise this rule where a regression could change a reader or lifecycle outcome.

applicability: Invariant publication and display by builds that serve the KNO-R04 title contract.
conditions: New invariants require a one-line title of at most 80 characters.
A legacy untitled revision remains writable with a notice; the brief and short answer derive a readable first-clause display title up to roughly 80 characters without mutating the record.
A title-only edit preserves the invariant revision.
exclusions: The title has no effect on statement meaning, review identity or state/writer standing.

evidence: KNO-R04 evidence E07 and focused rule-title tests.

statement: New rules require a title and legacy rules without one can still be displayed and revised.
title: New rules require titles and legacy untitled rules display first clause
